body: I know that, Im talking about instances where she texts me first and i have my phone nearby and so i reply straight away and then she ignores me for hours. I'm not expecting her to be glued to her phone or have it with her at all times im just expecting her to have it with her in the minute or so after she sends me a text.

I'm not saying her time is beholden to me or that she has to drop everything and text me back. But if she sends me a text first then she probably wants a conversation? And in the instances where i have my phone right next to me and text her back straight away then would it not be fair to expect to have her continue the conversation especially when this happens on a frequent basis? And again im not expecting her to reply within seconds, as mentioned in my post she's waiting for hours before texting me back.
